summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the FASE 1 conversion-oriented homepage restructure (DocuAnalytics AI) on the public preview URL. Verified new Hero, all 10 new sections and every requested data-testid, anchor scrolling, pricing preview fed by GET /api/crypto/info, pricing modal (stripe/crypto/paypal tabs), full regression of upload+AI analysis (credits 3->2, 13 fields, Red-Flag audit, wow-bar, after-analysis CTA), AI Copilot chat, CSV/JSON export, auth register+logout, i18n IT/EN/DE on the NEW copy, and mobile 390x844 layout. Core flows all pass with zero app console errors. Found 1 HIGH mobile layout bug (results grid overflows viewport), 1 desktop overlap bug in final CTA, and 1 CSS specificity bug that renders all prices as a big euro sign + tiny grey digits.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (390x844) the results grid uses inline style gridTemplateColumns: '1.4fr 1fr' with no responsive fallback, so it stays 2 columns and overflows horizontally: the right column (AI Red-Flag Audit, AI Copilot title + chat-input/chat-send) is cut off outside the viewport and unreachable. Reproduced after a real analysis on mobile; document.querySelectorAll scan returned multiple elements with right > innerWidth (DIV.glass pad mb1, DIV.audit-item audit-ok, DIV.audit-item audit-warning...). Fix: move the inline style to a class (e.g. .results-grid) and add @media(max-width:860px){grid-template-columns:1fr}.

The free-note line and the CTA button overlap on desktop: note box y=955 h=17 while [data-testid='trial-cta'] box y=939 h=47 and x starts at the end of the note text, visually covering '...Nessuna carta richiesta'. Cause: .hero-free is display:inline-flex and the following <button> is also inline-level inside a text-align:center container, so they share the same line. Mobile (390) is OK. Fix: wrap the note in a block-level div (or set .final-cta .hero-free{display:flex;justify-content:center} and make the button display:block/margin:auto).

All prices render as a large bold euro sign followed by tiny 14.4px, 35%-opacity digits (e.g. '€ 49', '€ 149') in both #prezzi cards and the pricing modal. Root cause: the bare descendant rule '.price-amt span{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--text-muted)}' (App.css:102) also matches the span that wraps the dynamic {p.amount} expression, not only the '/mese' suffix. Fix: give the suffix its own class (<span className="per">) and scope the rule to '.price-amt .per'. Affects every plan card and hurts the pricing readability of the new conversion section.

doc-card elements have no onClick, while sector-card, cop-example, rf-cta, how-cta and trial-cta all scroll to #upload. Clicking data-testid='doc-card-fattura' does nothing (page stays put, chip-fattura not selected) although the cards look interactive. Suggest making each doc-card select the matching chip and scroll to #upload for consistency/conversion.

issues: Crypto tab layout stays 2 columns (inline '1fr 1fr'): no overflow but the package select and BTC/USDT tabs are very cramped and labels wrap to 2 lines

Non-blocking dev-only React hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') caused by the visual-editor instrumentation injecting spans into <option> inside data-testid='crypto-pkg' - not app code, will not appear in a production build

rca_of_the_issue: Mobile results overflow: Results() renders <div className='grid' style={{gridTemplateColumns:'1.4fr 1fr'}}> - an inline style that no media query can override, so the two-column layout persists at 390px and the second column is pushed outside the viewport. Price rendering: the un-scoped CSS descendant selector '.price-amt span' catches the dynamic-expression span wrapping the amount, shrinking/greying the digits. Final CTA overlap: .hero-free{display:inline-flex} keeps the note inline, so the sibling inline-flex button shares the same line inside the centered .final-cta container.
